title: 从业近60年的马克斯：勤奋交易反而没回报，长期拿住才是关键
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: Well, I mean the charts of what the stock did yesterday, the reference to what the stock is doing
segments.zh: 嗯，我是说昨天股价走势图，以及今天股价表现的参考

segments.en: today, whether it's having a strong or a weak opening, whether the stock A is doing better than stock B today, these aren't the things that matter. What your viewers should try to do is put
segments.zh: 无论是高开还是低开，今天A权益资产是否比B权益资产表现更好，这些都不是关键。你的观众应该做的是构建一个长期有效的**组合并坚持持有。

segments.en: together a portfolio of things that will work in the long run and stay with it. There is no reward in the investment business for hyperactivity. What I say is important is buying pieces of companies
segments.zh: 在**行业，过度活跃没有回报。我认为重要的是买入成长型公司的部分股权，并向能回报我们的公司放贷。这就是我们要做的全部。

segments.en: that grow and lending money to companies that will pay us back. That's all we have to do.
segments.zh: 并向能回报我们的公司放贷。这就是我们要做的全部。
